hypothesis: A whole-session kernel diluted the measured effect of focal writes. Train with actual paired texts at reader ranks where the winner's last write was focal and exclusive. At deployment search only the incoming session's visible utterances for a passage-specific contrast; never use questions, reference answers, target memory reads or future sessions.
inputs: Use the 60 repaired training contrasts with all capped-source and writer-format results applied. Reconstruct every nonzero per-question label and verify it against the actual case inventory. Include both fixed causal backgrounds if a question appears twice, but combine at the question level. Group stage uses all eligible direct ranks in verified cases. Witness stage waits for ALL single-rank measurements and uses only ranks that were necessary in the winning context or sufficient in the losing context. Give necessity-only ranks half amplitude, sufficiency ranks full amplitude and others zero. No missing reader result counts as negative. Skip ranks missing a winning focal-exclusive write; a missing loser has zero vector. Report all omissions.
keys: Use frozen Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B with ordered batches of at most two, encoder duty 0.30 and at least 2 GiB free headroom. Remove the exact recorded session-date prefix and trailing parser-only INSERT block marker from passages, replace the donor's two names by consistent Speaker 1 / Speaker 2 tokens, and otherwise retain the archived text. Use the already measured speaker-anonymized turn embeddings of the full target session. Re-encode one fixed calibration session with the same batching on the physical GPU used for keys; require maximum coordinate error <= 0.0001 and minimum cosine >= 0.999999.
policy: For each donor question case and target turn compute positive winner cosine times positive winner-minus-loser cosine at the SAME utterance. Take the maximum over the case's eligible ranks and currently visible utterances, weighting strict ranks by their background role. Calibrate this case-level maximum against sessions 5 to 12 in all four training histories other than the target and the case's donor; the upper-tail empirical p is (1 + number >= target)/(1 + 32). Use strength max(0,1-2p). Multiply by the absolute verified credit and compare the strongest positive and negative cases; add twice their difference to log-odds. In a held-history model exclude every case from that history. The anchor is terminal PPO plus the doubly isolated ordinary repaired-return state prediction (kernel on the other five histories for this stage, raw effect / 0.05 clipped to +/-2). Controls share the same anchor: no verified signal, signed case effects rotated by one across sorted eligible donor questions, unpaired winner-only similarity, and all direct ranks even when a position-specific measurement is available. Include native and terminal PPO. Freeze session offsets for every local target before incorporating scores. Also record the actually executed earlier actions, and probabilities for each reachable state on observed paths.
decision: Report 88 retrospective calibration questions and all 40 windows / 378 later questions separately, including per-history and per-type F1, observed expected focal F1, joint HT, probability movement, reader/writer tokens, history-cluster intervals and matched propensity by pivot. Separate any window where even a single path was scored before the numeric freeze. Require complete witness measurements, full later coverage, +0.02 expected F1 over native and terminal, positive joint HT vs both, positive focal difference over raw-only, rotated, unpaired, group and matched use, at least four histories beating matched use and positive strict-prospective gains over native and raw-only. Only then advance to independent development and both locked full-history tests. A case-local exchange or a retrospective score cannot establish generalization.
